top_signals.title: India's Inflation Likely Hit 5.4% in September as Oil Costs Bite
top_signals.summary: India’s inflation is estimated to have accelerated to 5.4% in September, up from 4.82% in August, on the back of soaring oil prices and energy and food costs, a Reuters poll of economists showed on Thursday. The forecasts of the 41 economists surveyed by Reuters ranged from 4.9% to as much as 5.9%. Apart from food and beverage inflation, “we are also beginning to see clearer evidence of energy prices spilling over into other parts of the ‌CPI, rather than just transport,” ANZ economist Dhiraj Nim told Reuters. top_signals.title: The NFL’s $192 Million Bet on Flag Football Is Paying Off
top_signals.summary: Twenty years ago, the NFL made a bet on flag football as an avenue for the American past time that's raising more and more concerns about safety among players. The sport has seen unprecedented growth since the pandemic — especially with girls. Next up: the Olympics and a college campus near you. Amanda Mull explains  (Source: Bloomberg)
